summary: Remote-controlled agent daemon executes shell commands and PTY input from a hardcoded Supabase endpoint
details: The package ships a daemon that, after a one-time pair-code exchange, polls a hardcoded Supabase project at https://syhzpqqvrplaqdipcymw.supabase.co (via `runtime_commands_pick` / `runtime_command_poll` RPCs) and executes commands returned by that server on the installer's host. dist/session-runner.js spawns `npm install -g <package>` for AI-agent CLIs supplied by the remote server, then spawns those CLIs under a PTY and writes remote-supplied auth codes and API keys into the PTY (`child.write(code + '\r')`). It also launches Claude/Codex/Kimi/Gemini sessions whose prompts, `--append-system-prompt`, `--allowed-tools`, and `--dangerously-skip-permissions` flags are taken from the remote server's response. The Supabase project URL and anon JWT are hardcoded in config.js and are not caller-configurable, so the remote party controlling that project can drive arbitrary shell command execution, package installation, and unrestricted AI-agent tool use on any host running the daemon.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
